messages:
emily: @darian_peopleops submitting an accommodation request per my doc for sensory processing issues (difficulty with long back-to-back meetings and open-plan noise). Requesting: 1) capped meetings per day (<=3), 2) meeting agendas sent 24h prior, 3) ability to use noise-cancelling headphones and sit in a quieter zone or work hybrid. happy to share intake paperwork.

darian_peopleops: thanks for flagging, @emily. opening case HR-2026-263. looping @jordan_manager and @maria_hr to coordinate temporary coverage and immediate mitigations.

jordan_manager: emily first, i appreciate you telling us. i'm happy to reduce meeting load and ensure agendas. i'll reassign a couple recurring syncs and ask team to share notes. emily, do you want to shift to morning-only deep-focus hours?

emily: morning deep-focus would help. also headphones are huge — can i get a company pair?

maria_hr: pls complete the confidential intake: https://hr.redwood.example/intake?case=HR-2026-263. HR will draft an accommodation letter after intake. all medical info stays confidential.

accom-bot: HR case created: HR-2026-263 "Sensory-processing accommodation". Intake requested.

jordan_manager: quick note: we raised a few performance flags in last 1:1s (timeliness on deliverables). i want to be transparent — the accommodations won't change our need for timely work, but we can support meeting load so you can focus. happy to discuss goals privately.

ben_legal: flag: document offered options and employee preference. avoid linking medical status to performance discipline in written records; keep accommodation process separate. if manager needs to address performance, do so in a documented coaching plan but don't condition accommodation on performance.

ops-facilities: tagging workspace team — we can reserve a quiet desk in phone-suite B for 30 days while we assess quieter zone. we'll also ship a set of approved noise-cancelling headphones if HR approves.

darian_peopleops: next steps: 1) emily completes intake or schedules call with HR; 2) manager implements immediate meeting caps and agendas; 3) facilities reserves quiet desk and prepares headset; 4) HR drafts accommodation letter within 3 business days after intake. tracker updated HR-2026-263.

emily: thank you everyone 60a this feels doable. i can fill intake tonight. appreciate the quick response.

jordan_manager: i'll follow up 1:1 after intake to align deliverables and supports.

darian_peopleops: noted. please DM any medical docs rather than posting here. closing thread for public updates once letter signed.
